newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa in first real counts of blacks, homeless.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa in first real counts of blacks, homeless.

text.p: Scrawny homeless children and bleary-eyed drunks emerged out of rubbish bins and cardboard boxes on Thursday as South Africa started its first census that will tally blacks and others never counted before.
Up until 1991, when the last census was held, the number of blacks in South Africa was estimated -- like antelope herds on the veld -- from aerial photographs of townships and squatter camps.
Prostitutes and homeless people were not tallied at all in the old South Africa, which was divided into ethnic homelands.
But this three-week census, the first since all-race elections in 1994 hammered the final nail into apartheid's coffin, is being held under the banner "Count us in".
The statutory Central Statistical Service (CSS) has employed creative ways to improve the count, inviting homeless people to 120 street parties across the land.

As the sun cast its first rays on the broken panes of a forlorn-looking building in Johannesburg's semi-slum Hillbrow district, a hung-over group lurched to the Hillbrow park where music blared from a promised breakfast party.
"It is a good idea to know how many people are suffering so that it can be stopped," said William Nkoane, 18, and an eight-year veteran of the streets.
Counters in the Hillbrow district said the country would be shocked at the number of destitute people bursting onto the streets outside the grimy buildings.

"We found homeless children and adults in nooks and crannies nobody probably knows even exist," said Dorothy McLaren, one of 80,000 people hired to visit an estimated one million households with questionnaires in all of South Africa's 11 official languages.

"The extent of the homeless population is something nobody has reckoned with. On some pavements we found up to 10 people sleeping next to each other," she said, adding that almost all of the homeless people were black.
The 356 million rand ($78.5 million) exercise aims to provide accurate information on unemployment and identify areas of greatest need for water, electricity, schools, hospitals or roads.
The homeless man Nkoane was so taken with the idea that he spent the rainy night showing counters the odd spots where indigents are living, McLaren said.
A University of South Africa (Unisa) survey published in August found the black population to be around 32 million, with about 5.2 million whites.

The university estimated the country's total population, including people from the old apartheid classifications of Asian and mixed-race coloured, was 41.8 million, with a growth rate of around 2,1 percent per annum.

That total excludes illegal aliens. Estimates of the number of unlawful foreigners in South Africa ranges from two million to eight million people, which would dramatically swell the total headcount. ($1=4.55 rand)
